name: ZeroDayBench
description: ZeroDayBench is a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on their ability to find and patch 22 novel zero-day vulnerabilities in open-source codebases, focusing on proactive cyberdefense capabilities of frontier LLMs.
reputation: A very new, niche benchmark from a recent arXiv paper, so it has limited community adoption so far but is relevant to frontier cyberdefense research.
notes: Focuses on novel critical vulnerabilities and evaluates frontier LLMs like GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Grok 4.1.
